years.note: Method: one-time resources used to balance the budget; the review states no one-time expenditure offset. 'The FY 2014 budget was balanced by using approximately $19.6 million (44%) in ongoing resources and $23.7 million (56%) in one-time resources' (p.1). Largest item: $21.6M one-time SDG&E settlement funds from the Public Liability Reserve (p.1); the remainder is not itemized, so components are null.

source.doc: IBA Report 14-15, Review of the FY 2015 Proposed Budget

years.note: Reported as zero (judgment call): the review gives no dollar figure but says 'With negligible use of one-time resources and sound revenue assumptions, this proposed budget and its corresponding service levels are likely more sustainable than those proposed over the past eight years.' (p.1).

Not reported: IBA Report 15-16 (Review of the FY 2016 Proposed Budget, https://www.sandiego.gov/sites/default/files/15_16_150427.pdf) states no amount of one-time resources used for ongoing costs and no structural deficit or balance statement for FY 2016.
Not reported: IBA Report 16-05 (Review of the FY 2017 Proposed Budget) states no amount of one-time resources used for ongoing costs and no structural deficit or balance statement for FY 2017.

Not reported: IBA Report 17-16 itemizes one-time balancing resources in its $81.0M mitigation chart (p.2-3: Pension Payment Stabilization Reserve $16.0M, Risk Management reserves $15.5M, Excess Equity $8.3M, Chargers lease termination fee $8.3M, Capital Outlay Fund $4.0M) but states no total and no net of one-time expenditures (part of the Chargers fee funds one-time election costs), so no figure is recorded.

Not reported: IBA Report 18-08 itemizes one-time balancing resources (p.2-3: Excess Equity $12.3M; fund balances, transfers and reimbursements $14.4M; Workers' Comp/LTD excess reserves $5.6M) but states no total and no structural deficit figure, so no figure is recorded.

Not reported: IBA Report 19-06 says '62% [of the $72.4M of balancing actions] are one-time' (p.3) and itemizes them (Excess Equity $30.7M, LTD reserve $4.8M, Infrastructure Fund $4.0M, Public Liability reserve $2.6M, Capital Outlay Fund $2.5M) but states no dollar total and no net of one-time expenditures, so no figure is recorded.

Not reported: IBA Report 20-06 says the budget uses 'one-time resources to support ongoing expenditures' and that 'such one-time resources include $7.9 million in Pension Payment Stabilization Reserve funds and $16.9 million in anticipated stadium sale proceeds' (p.8), a partial list with no total, so no figure is recorded.
